snippet.title: MAJJAM - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎶 Sign up for the Closed Alpha ! – September 2025: https://majja.me/trailer
Are you ready to jam to save the world?
Join the wonderful world of MAJJAM and play with your friends to save the world through the power of music. 

Majjam is a multiplayer adventure where music is magic. As an evil presence is surrounding peaceful places of the world, a band of heroes is assembling to protect their lands through their weapons of choice : their musical instruments. Unlock enchanting melodies, master special abilities and team up with your friends to discover the secrets the world of Majjam holds, fighting back the evil.

Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/E2AtSh3mnf

Follow us:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845650/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@MajjamGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/MajjamGame
X: https://x.com/MajjamGame
